summary: Iteration 40 — Final backend validation post .dockerignore rewrite. NO backend code changed; only Docker build context filter was modified. Re-ran the full iter39 regression suite (16 pytest cases) → 16/16 PASS in 12.36s. All requested checks confirmed: (1) backend boots cleanly under supervisor (uptime 47min, no import errors); (2) GET /api/health returns 200 {status:healthy}; (3) GET /api/ banner returns valid JSON (name/status/version/docs/health); (4) POST /api/plume-chat with birth_data still responds (Solena reply + 🪶 + markdown); (5) GET /api/rencontres/ultime/status handles all 5 stages (missing/empty/unknown/delivered/pending); (6) PACKS (Initiation 4.99€/15cr, Clarté 14.99€/50+10, Flammes Jumelles 29.99€/100+30) + SERVICE_COSTS GaryVee grid intact (tarot_oui_non=5, chat_astral=10, tarot_marseille=30, lecture_astrologique=40, theme_natal_pdf=60, + full coverage).

minor.issue: Non-blocking upstream 400 seen in backend.err.log during plume-chat calls. Fallback path is used and test still passes. Not a regression — behavior was identical in iter39.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: .dockerignore rewrite is well-scoped — only excludes dev/test/cache artefacts and generated PDFs. Runtime backend/frontend code is preserved intact.
GOOD: `**/.env` exclusion is correct (envs come via K8s secrets in Emergent deploy, not baked into image).
GOOD: `backend/tests/` exclusion is safe — pytest suite lives outside the runtime image, reducing build context.
GOOD: `*.md` exclusion at root plus `docs/` — good for image size, no runtime dependency on markdown files.

MINOR (heritage from iter38/39): test_iteration32_new_pricing.py remains outdated (asserts astro_amour=40cr/12.99€, no longer in pricing config). Would break a full regression run. Suggest main agent delete or rewrite the file.

NOTE: The `wakeup_environment: context deadline exceeded` was an Emergent infra timeout — .dockerignore is the correct mitigation lever (shrinks context sent to builder). No app-side change was necessary and none was made.
test_credentials: N/A — all tested endpoints are public/anonymous.
seed_data_creation: None new. Reused iter39 seeded ultime sessions (cs_test_ultime_cb14f284e18c delivered, cs_test_pending_b53848d041e1 pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 = GO for production deploy. .dockerignore change is transparent to the running app. Regression suite: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration39_health_check.py -v` (~12s, 16/16). No new bugs, no regressions detected. Astrology-api 400 in logs is a known non-blocking upstream and not caused by .dockerignore.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defect. The original deployment failure (`wakeup_environment: context deadline exceeded`) was Emergent orchestration-side. Adding `.dockerignore` reduces the Docker build context transmitted to the builder (excludes .git/, node_modules/, __pycache__/, generated PDFs, high-res library PNGs, test suites, dev plugins, memory/, test_reports/) which is the recommended fix for build-context timeouts. Backend runtime behaviour is unchanged.
